name: M3 planning (the next milestone)
summary: The deterministic sim core (M2) and the actor system (M2.5) are complete; M1.5 is one playtest from closing. M3 is the next big block of game, and its plan doesn't exist yet. The M2.5 plan document is the template: work items in dependency order, per-item acceptance criteria, verifier procedures.
requirements: An M3 scope ruling from the CEO: which slice of the phase arc M3 delivers
The two opening design questions ruled (the interaction inventory and the phase-content question carried in the designer queue)
A written M3 plan on the M2.5 template, with exit gate defined as measured criteria
current_status: Unblocked and next in line. Planning has not begun in earnest — it was explicitly queued behind the T-35/T-36 fixes, which have both shipped. The first concrete step is a scope proposal for the CEO to rule on.

plan.step: Draft 2-3 candidate M3 scopes with cost estimates (strawman from Product + Design)
CEO rules on scope and the opening design questions
Write the M3 plan on the M2.5 template

plan_note: Plan is intentionally incomplete — this project is pre-execution. The plan firms up when the scope ruling lands.
